PROTOCOL VERIFIED 2026-09-11 before the arm was written, because 'Anthropic-compatible' is a claim and not a guarantee: tool_use returns a real tool_use block with stop_reason=tool_use; a tool_result multi-turn continuation answers from the tool output; SSE streaming emits the full message_start/content_block_delta/message_delta/message_stop sequence; thinking blocks come back as type=thinking; and prompt caching HONOURS cache_control (6769 tok cache_creation cold, then cache_read on two consecutive warm calls). The caching check is load-bearing for cost - the Kimi K3 wave showed a missing cache is a ~3x bill. EFFORT: the endpoint validates LOUDLY - output_config.effort 400-rejects an invented value AND names its accept-list (low, medium, high, xhigh, max), so it cannot silently clamp the way Moonshot's 200-for-anything endpoint does. Note the two DashScope surfaces do NOT share an accept-list: the OpenAI-compatible /compatible-mode/v1 surface also takes none and minimal, the Anthropic one rejects both. A dial is per serving path, so only the Anthropic surface - the one Claude Code ships on - was probed. MAGNITUDE PROBED 2026-09-11 on this exact surface, n=3 per tier, one fixed multi-step reasoning prompt, 32K cap, nothing truncated (receipt effort-dial-probes/20260911-qwen38flash-dashscope-anthropic.txt): the dial is REAL but it SATURATES. Mean output tokens with thinking included run low=3557, medium=4579, high=19329, xhigh=17934, max=16121. low and medium sit in bands that do not overlap the top three at all, and the 5.43x spread between the lowest and highest means clears the worst within-tier spread of 2.00x, so this route is NOT an inert dial - asking for max genuinely buys ~4.5x the thinking of low. BUT high, xhigh and max are mutually INDISTINGUISHABLE: sample ranges 13933-27933, 12523-24778 and 13767-19431 overlap almost entirely, and the means DECREASE as the nominal tier rises, which is noise rather than an inversion. So max is the top value this endpoint accepts and it binds against the bottom of the dial, while buying nothing measurable over high. Do NOT read this row as more thinking than a high row. Separately, the greedy fingerprint does not work here: four identical xhigh calls at temperature 0 returned four DIFFERENT thinking hashes (text hash stable), so thinking is non-deterministic on this endpoint and byte-comparison cannot resolve tier aliases - only distributions can, which is why this probe is n=3 and range-based. THIS IS THE LOW-EFFORT HALF OF A PAIRED COMPARISON - its sibling arm qwen38flash runs the same model on the same endpoint at max. OpenRouter serves a Responses-compatible endpoint, so the shim answers the catalog route and forwards the turn unchanged - no translation of the conversation, the tools or the stream.
